svg.title: API1 — POST /invoices happy path
svg.desc: Request flow for invoice creation from client through gateway to database
svg.text: Same key + same hash + COMPLETED → return cached 201 (no DB write)
PROCESSING → 409 | Same key + different request hash → 409
subtotal = Σ(qty × unit_price per line) | tax = Σ(subtotal × tax_rate per line) | total = subtotal + tax
due_date = invoice_date + payment_terms_days | credit_limit checked before insert
